title: Restriction of sheaves of sets along an etale localization is left adjoint to base-change direct image
statement: Let $S$ and $T$ be schemes and let $\mathcal C=T_{\Et}$ and $\mathcal D=S_{\Et}$ be their small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], let $\lambda:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and $\beta:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be functors with $\lambda\dashv\beta$ and counit $\varepsilon:\lambda\beta\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D}$. Assume precomposition with each functor carries sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] to sheaves of sets, and write $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$, $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ for the categories of sheaves of sets. Then precomposition $\lambda^s:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ is left adjoint to precomposition $\beta^s:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$, and its unit at a sheaf $G$ is the morphism whose component at $W\in\mathcal D$ is $G(\varepsilon_W):G(W)\to G(\lambda\beta W)$. If $L:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ is another left adjoint to $\beta^s$ with unit $\eta$, there is a unique natural isomorphism $\rho:L\xrightarrow{\sim}\lambda^s$ satisfying $\beta^s(\rho_G)\circ\eta_G=G(\varepsilon)$ for every sheaf $G$.
